title: Jet (mathematics)
extract: In mathematics, the jet is an operation that takes a differentiable function f and produces a polynomial, the Taylor polynomial of f, at each point of its domain. Although this is the definition of a jet, the theory of jets regards these polynomials as being abstract polynomials rather than polynomial functions.
